# Draft:Marion F. Edwards

Marion Edwards should link here
Marion F. Edwards (born June 23, 1941) is a judge in Louisiana who served as Chief Judge of the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. He was inducted into the Louisiana Political Hall of Fame.
A native of Monroe, Louisiana, he graduated from Ouachita Parish High School and Northeast Louisiana University. He received his J.D. Loyola University School of Law in 1967.
